nodes.name: Crank Arm
nodes.description: The crank arm carries the chainring and mounts on the bottom bracket spindle; a crank puller threads into it and pushes against the spindle to remove it.

evidence.quote: Tighten crank puller to extract crank arm from bottom bracket spindle.
evidence.section: 5.  If bottom bracket service is required, use appropriate BB tool to remove bearing cups. Note thread direction: Right side is usually reverse-threaded.

nodes.name: Chainring
nodes.description: The toothed front sprocket bolted to the crank arm.

evidence.quote: countersunk bolt holes for chainring attachment
evidence.section: C H R I S S I D W E L L S

edges.claim: Crank bolts secure the left and right cranks to the spindle, so the crank arm is joined to the bottom bracket spindle.

evidence.quote: Tighten crank puller to extract crank arm from bottom bracket spindle.
evidence.section: 5.  If bottom bracket service is required, use appropriate BB tool to remove bearing cups. Note thread direction: Right side is usually reverse-threaded.

edges.claim: Chainrings are toothed sprockets attached to the cranks.
